LanceDB Python client (lancedb 0.26.1) backed by Lance datasets.
Full-text search via LanceDB FTS (lance-index) with BM25 ranking.
Lucene-style '+' is mapped to boolean MUST/MUST_NOT; quoted phrases are treated as term AND queries (defaults do not store positions).
Counts are streamed from the internal query executor to avoid loading all results into memory.
